answer: Here is one mechanism that works: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because thread only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, cipher is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any cedar approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
